svg.title: Salta / Cafayate study map
svg.desc: Orientation map with representative study locations and selected rivers and towns. Country and state outlines are geographic context, not appellation boundaries. No vineyard parcels or elevation model are implied. 1: Cafayate; 2: San Carlos; 3: Molinos; 4: Cachi; 5: San Salvador de Jujuy; 6: San Antonio; 7: La Mendieta; 8: Salta; 9: San Pedro; 10: Libertador General San Martín; 11: Cerrillos; 12: San Antonio de los Cobres

g.text: Light markers: study locations · dark markers: geographic context · teal: water
